> What if:
>
> - The controller of the Rack is different from the controller of
> the vampire benefiting from the Rack? (amusing thought :) )

"The Rack now functions only while the controller of The Rack is the
controller of the affected vampire." [TOM 951124]

> - There are no ready vampires when I play The Rack. (is it
> possible to play it this way?)

It points to nothing, so no benefit is gained.

> - The vamp benefiting from The Rack is burnt?

It points to nothing, so no one benefits.

>[Re: Palatial Estate]
> The "loquipment" subject still eludes me in some subjects: Can a
> loquipment be transferred to another minion of the *same* methuselah via
> Disputed Territory?

Card text: "choose a location and a Methuselah." so, yes.

> Can it be brought into play via Magic of the Smith or
> Vast Wealth?

Yes. It is equipment until it is in play.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
LSJ <vte...@wizards.com> wrote:
> >[Re: Palatial Estate]
> > The "loquipment" subject still eludes me in some subjects: Can a
> > loquipment be transferred to another minion of the *same* methuselah via
> > Disputed Territory?
>
> Card text: "choose a location and a Methuselah." so, yes.

....salem christ.... made the comment (via private e-mail) that
> [LSJ] ruled for form of
> corruption that giving the edge to a methuselah who already has it with
> regaining the upper hand has no effect. regaining the upper hand has the
> same template as disputed territory. so, technically, you shouldn't be able
> to move locations around your own minions with it.

Absolutely correct.

REVERSAL: Transferring Locquipment via Disputed Territory to the *same*
Methuselah that currently controls the locquipment results in no effect -
the locquipment may *not* be moved to a different minion of the same
Methuselah. (Similarly, transferring the Rack from yourself to yourself
doesn't allow you to choose a new target).

I apologize for the oversight.


